title: Moldog
body:
"Suspiciously delicious while being possibly nutricious"

Description

Moldog is an item sold at River Shop for 10 Credits. It serves no purpose and can be used for decoration. If you eat it, you will die.

Appearance

Moldog is a hotdog covered in green mold, similar in texture to Mythril.

Despite being of similar nature, Moldog uses a unique model, unlike Hotdog that uses a Roblox gear "Hotdog" as it's model.
